documentation_audit.command:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
p=Path('docs/workstreams/research/AF-RES-003')
base='9d728dfe2c2f3a13d9995b5fdc14a252aeddfdad'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],text=True).strip()
head=git('rev-parse','HEAD')
files=sorted(x for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file())
changed=git('diff','--name-only',base,head).splitlines()
assert changed and all(s.startswith(str(p)+'/') for s in changed),changed
assert git('rev-parse',base+':docs/automation/dot-control.json')==git('rev-parse',head+':docs/automation/dot-control.json')
source_sets={}
for name,prefix,expected in [('SOURCES-IDENTITY.md','I',12),('SOURCES-MECHANISMS.md','M',10),('SOURCES-STANDARDS.md','R',12)]:
    ids=re.findall(r'^### ('+prefix+r'\d{2})\b',(p/name).read_text(),re.M)
    assert ids==[f'{prefix}{i:02}' for i in range(1,expected+1)],(name,ids)
    source_sets[name]=ids
counted=set(source_sets['SOURCES-IDENTITY.md'][:-1]+source_sets['SOURCES-MECHANISMS.md']+source_sets['SOURCES-STANDARDS.md'])
assert len(counted)==33
cases=re.findall(r'^## (C\d{2})\b',(p/'CASES.md').read_text(),re.M)
assert cases==[f'C{i:02}' for i in range(1,10)],cases
all_source_ids=counted|{'I12'}
for name in ['RESEARCH.md','CASES.md']:
    found=set(re.findall(r'\b[IMR]\d{2}\b',(p/name).read_text()))
    assert found<=all_source_ids,(name,found-all_source_ids)
links=[]
for f in files:
    if f.suffix!='.md':continue
    text=f.read_text()
    assert not re.search(r'^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)',text,re.M),str(f)
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
        if re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:',target) or target.startswith('#'):continue
        local=target.split('#',1)[0]
        assert (f.parent/local).exists(),(str(f),target)
        links.append({'from':f.name,'to':target})
review=(p/'REVIEW.md').read_text()
reviewed={name:sha for name,sha in re.findall(r'\| `([^`]+\.md)` \| `([0-9a-f]{64})` \|',review)}
assert len(reviewed)==5,reviewed
for name,sha in reviewed.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((p/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,name
json.loads((p/'task-manifest.json').read_text())
whitespace=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check',base,head],text=True,capture_output=True)
assert whitespace.returncode==0,whitespace.stdout+whitespace.stderr
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','checked_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'checked_out_commit':head,'base_commit':base,'python':sys.version.split()[0],'git':git('--version'),'changed_paths':changed,'dot_control_unchanged':True,'counted_originals':len(counted),'source_groups':source_sets,'excluded_from_count':['I12'],'cases':cases,'relative_links':links,'review_input_hashes_match':reviewed,'files_sha256':{str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files},'git_diff_check_exit_code':whitespace.returncode,'worktree_status_before_receipt':git('status','--porcelain'),'limits':['No external link availability sweep; source bodies were read during research.','No product execution, cost benchmark, user study, or integration testing.']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
